title: Nobody is safe from celebrity AI deepfakes
hook_before: Mia Goth is the latest face of Instagram AI slop.
script:
Zero celebrities are safe from Instagram AI deepfakes. Mia Goth is the latest face of this content.
The images show her posing in a fake T-shirt about her ex.
These deepfakes use generative AI to manipulate celebrity likenesses.
Instagram recently struggled to flag this specific fake content.
One viral post even featured audio of a song to sell the lie.
Soon, identifying real photos from AI will be impossible for most users.
Would you trust a photo of a celebrity on your feed?
